Name: Rewilding Pelican Town
Author: runswithpencils
Description:
Once you reach ten hearts with Robin, you will receive a letter in the post and her shop will now sell the following rewilding items:
Maple Seeds, Acorns, Pine Cones, Mahogany Seeds, Sap, Tree Fertiliser, Clay, Mixed Seeds and Fiber seeds, they are sold in limited quantities, but are replenished daily.

Downloads.Description: Rewild Pelican Town with supplies from Robins Shop! (Must reach ten heart friendship level to unlock)

Manifest.Name: LetterFromRobin
Manifest.Description: Adds a letter in post from Robin once you have reached ten hearts, explaining her rewilding venture.
Manifest.Author: runswithpencils

Manifest.Name: RewildingShop
Manifest.Description: Adds tree seeds, tree fert, sap, clay and fiber to Robins Shop
